pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: The Tale of Squirrel Nutkin
work.note: "The Tale of Squirrel Nutkin" é um livro ilustrado de Beatrix Potter, publicado em 1903. A aula retorna à obra para explorar “duas palavras de tempo: still (ainda, continua) e already (já)”. A referência mostra a impaciência do esquilo: “Is it ready yet?”.

facts.sub: Em dias de muita neve, as ruas ficam perigosas e as escolas fecham. As famílias ouvem a notícia na TV ou recebem um aviso no celular.

facts.label: Vista-se bem

pages.title: A snowy morning · 1/3
paragraphs: It is seven in the morning in a snowy neighborhood in Chicago. White snow covers the roofs and the cars. Leo looks out his window with wide eyes. The street is silent and bright. He runs downstairs to find his mother. She is making tea in the kitchen.
“Mom, look outside! It’s snowing a lot!” says Leo. “I see. Let’s check the news.” says Mom. “Is school closed today?” says Leo.

pages.title: A snowy morning · 3/3
paragraphs: “Yes, but come back by lunch. Hot soup is ready then.” says Mom. “Okay! This is the best day ever!” says Leo. Leo eats breakfast fast and puts on his warm clothes. He goes outside and meets his friend Ben. They roll big balls of snow in the yard. They build a snowman with a carrot nose. At noon, Leo comes home and drinks hot soup. A snow day turns a normal day into a gift.
